paragraphs: A private, phone-friendly AI chat that brings free models from Google AI Studio (Gemini), OpenRouter, Groq and Cerebras together in one place, and switches to another model automatically when one hits its free limit. It reads your files and creates real Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF documents.
features: Invite-only: only the Google accounts listed in firestore.rules can use the app; others see a "Not invited" screen.
Google sign-in; API keys are entered once in Settings → API keys and saved privately in Firestore.
One chat, many models: pick any model per chat, or retry an answer with a different one.

Auto routing: picks the best enabled model for each message (images, long documents, code, maths, web search, files, Arabic, quick replies) and saves the scarce Pro limits for heavy work. A manually chosen model is kept…
Automatic switching: if a model hits its limit, errors, hangs (no response in 45 s), returns nothing or is blocked, the next model answers; a rejected key skips that provider's other models.
